facts.fact: Clara 在 Ben 的纽约私宅醒来——Ben 抱她穿镜回现代、雇私人医生取子弹（枪伤进医院问题太多）。
facts.anchor: We left William’s house because I wasn’t going to let some doctor in the past butcher you trying to remove a bullet from your shoulder.

facts.fact: 逃生回忆：Ben 与 Quint 扶她的手到镜面，Quint 在发间低声安慰，把抱着的她递给 Ben——最后记忆是 Quint 的 Come back to me, love。
facts.anchor: Both of them holding my hands to the surface, Quint’s lips in my hair as he whispered words of comfort.

facts.fact: Gibbons 穿镜回到现代后失联（训练有素无法追踪）；任务组在找。
facts.anchor: “He came back to the present and went off the grid.

facts.fact: McCann 镜子仍在 Allen 庄园——Quint 的遗嘱里特意写明镜子留宅（为回家留路）。
facts.anchor: there was something in Quint’s will about making sure it stayed in the house.

facts.fact: 实证：Clara 出生在过去的 1911 前后——父母生在未来、她的出生证是伪造的（联邦索引卡 S.F. Co.）。
facts.anchor: Your parents weren’t, but you were. Your birth certificate is the only thing forged

facts.fact: Ben 反对 Clara 去问父母（那意味着穿越回去）——「我们掺和得还不够多吗？」
facts.anchor: He sits back, pressing his hands together. “Haven’t we meddled enough?”

facts.fact: Quint 1939 年 34 岁才结婚（娶 Catherine Pratt）——他等了她二十多年。
facts.anchor: After you left, he didn’t marry until 1939—he was thirty-four years old.

facts.fact: Clara 心里的 Quint 之歌「全是错音符与生疏的节拍」——与 Ben 的1928争吵在此刻显出重量。
facts.anchor: The song that Quint had written inside of me feels full of wrong notes now and an unpracticed tempo.

facts.fact: 章末：Clara 长久无法入睡——「可能再也无法安心入睡」。
facts.anchor: It’s a long time before I actually fall asleep, and it might be a much longer time before I rest with any peace of mind again.
